description:
The 5G NR preset in `crates/gf2-sim/src/presets/nr_5g.rs` attaches no run plan, so `Pipeline::run` does not drive it; callers use `TopologyExecutor::run`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Pipeline::run` executes the 5G NR preset over its SNR sweep with checkpoint and resume, and a fixed seed produces the result of the `TopologyExecutor::run` path, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-02: The preset's Rustdoc states how it is run.
title: Sweep-level Pipeline::run for the 5G NR preset
